plan: Given my value of $35, I aim to bid strategically to win the prize without overpaying. The highest bid wins and pays the third-highest bid, so I must balance between bidding high enough to win and low enough to maximize profit. A bid slightly above the midpoint of my value, say $25, could outbid conservative opponents while ensuring a profit if I win.

Given my value of $32, I aim to bid below my value to ensure profit if I win. Rational opponents will likely bid close to their values, so bidding slightly below my value increases my chance of winning while ensuring profit. I will bid $30, as it is competitive yet allows a $2 profit margin if I win and pay the third-highest bid.

With a high private value of $48, I should bid aggressively to maximize profit. To win, my bid should exceed others, yet remain below my value to ensure profit. A bid near my value, slightly lower, increases my chance of winning while ensuring I pay less than $48 if successful. I will bid $45 to balance between winning probability and profit maximization, considering others will also bid strategically.
